business.name: Clear Cut
business.description: Clear Cut is a boutique strength and conditioning studio offering personal training, small-group HIIT classes, and body transformation coaching for clients who want visible, lasting results.

services.name: 1:1 Personal Training
services.description: Fully customized one-on-one coaching built around your specific goals, whether that's fat loss, muscle gain, or general performance.

services.name: Small-Group HIIT Classes
services.description: High-intensity interval training in small groups, so coaching still feels personal.

services.name: 12-Week Body Transformation Program
services.description: A structured program combining training, nutrition coaching, and progress tracking to help clients get visibly leaner and stronger.

services.name: Nutrition Coaching
services.description: One-on-one nutrition guidance to support training results, including meal planning and habit coaching.

services.name: Free Trial Class
services.description: A no-cost first class for new members to experience the coaching style before committing.

membership_plans.name: Unlimited Monthly
membership_plans.includes: Unlimited group classes, 10% off personal training

policies.cancellation: Classes can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 4 hours before the start time with no penalty. Late cancellations may forfeit the class credit.
policies.late_arrival: Clients arriving more than 10 minutes late may be asked to join the next available session for safety reasons.
policies.trial_offer: New clients get one free trial class before choosing a plan.

faqs.question: Do you offer a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes, new members get one free trial class before deciding on a plan.

faqs.question: Do I need any experience to join?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is needed. Sessions are coached and scaled to your current fitness level.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my first session?
faqs.answer: Comfortable workout clothes, athletic shoes, and a water bottle. Mats and equipment are provided.

faqs.question: Can I freeze or cancel my membership?
faqs.answer: Yes, memberships can be paused or cancelled with notice as outlined in the membership agreement.

faqs.question: Do you offer nutrition support?
faqs.answer: Yes, nutrition coaching is available as a standalone service or bundled with the transformation program.

booking.how_it_works: Clients can book a class, trial, or consultation directly through chat. The agent checks availability and confirms the booking automatically.
booking.confirmation_method: SMS and email confirmation sent immediately after booking
